sections.heading: About me
sections.body: I spent six years in-house before going independent in 2021, first at a grid analytics company and then leading design for a heat pump installer platform. That work taught me that climate software usually fails on operations rather than aesthetics: the installer standing on a roof in the rain does not care about your gradient. So I design for the messy middle, which means shadowing field teams, reading support tickets, and testing flows on cracked phones with bad signal. I work solo on most engagements and pull in a trusted engineer or copywriter when a project needs more hands. Clients get direct access to me, written weekly updates, and files they own outright.

sections.heading: How engagements run
sections.body: Every project starts with a paid one-week discovery: I read your support tickets, sit in on calls, and interview four or five users. At the end you get a written brief with the problems I found ranked by impact, plus a fixed price for the work I recommend. If you take the brief elsewhere, that is fine and the files are yours. Design happens in weekly cycles with a Friday demo, and I keep a running decision log so nobody has to reconstruct why a screen looks the way it does. I hand off Figma files, a component inventory, and a short recorded walkthrough for the engineers who will build it.

items.question: What does a project cost?
items.answer: Discovery weeks are 4,000 euros. Most full engagements land between 18,000 and 45,000 euros depending on scope, and retainers start at 7,500 euros per month.

items.question: Do you take equity instead of fees?
items.answer: Occasionally, for pre-seed teams working on grid or heat, and only as a partial offset against a discounted cash rate.

items.question: Can you write front-end code?
items.answer: I build production-quality React and Tailwind prototypes, but I do not ship application code. For build-out I bring in engineers I have worked with for years.

items.question: How far out are you booked?
items.answer: Usually six to ten weeks. Audits and discovery weeks can often start sooner because they are self-contained.
